wLineRecord.derivation: Alphabetical run 11 (2-OLEAMIDO-1,3-OCTADECANEDIOL) to 19 (TOCOPHERYL ACETATE): 9 ascending entries under the W-LINE comparison (digits sort before letters, so 2-OLEAMIDO@11 sorts before MENTHOL@10 and breaks the shorter run CARBOMER@7-MENTHOL@10). The run does not contain the earliest cleansing surfactant (SODIUM LAURETH SULFATE@2); its second entry PARFUM@12 is a candidate (class d) and is also the E3 marker (class a). No candidate precedes it. (i) SLES@2 before it; (ii) nothing between it and the cap -> plausible; W-line = cap = 12, no fallback code. Alternative reading (if the manufacturer's letter-sort of 2-OLEAMIDO is followed, run 7-19): tail candidate CI 19140@8, W-line 8. The formula has no payload_lipid, so either reading changes nothing.

cleansingStrength.rationale: moderate by C1: defining anionic SODIUM LAURETH SULFATE@2 (ether type) with the prominent buffer COCO-BETAINE@4 and no reinforcing strong anionic (the settled ether-sulfate-plus-betaine core).

conditioningLevel.rationale: moderate: one meaningful conditioning system - prominent DIMETHICONE@6 - with light routes (pearlizing GLYCOL DISTEARATE@3, GLYCERIN@5, ceramide-type 2-OLEAMIDO-1,3-OCTADECANEDIOL@11). C2 is not met: there is no cationic polymer. Counter-signal: without a cationic deposition aid, silicone deposition from an SLES chassis may be limited, so low is the realistic neighbor.

weightPotential.rationale: moderate: one plausibly persistent system - prominent DIMETHICONE@6 - in an ordinary C1 SLES/betaine chassis (reset moderate); bounded residue is plausible. No cationic polymer or conditioner, no payload lipid (W-line PARFUM@12 gates nothing), so neither W-RICH nor the convergence route for high exists.

weightPotential.counterevidence: No cationic polymer to aid silicone deposition; the second deposition family is only a trace ceramide-type additive after MENTHOL@10; moderate SLES reset.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: A prominent dimethicone is a plausibly persistent deposit; calling the product lightweight would understate the residue risk, while a single silicone without cationic aid and with moderate reset keeps it bounded.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: low rather than moderate would need the silicone to be light/late; it is the sixth entry, before Carbomer and the actives (W2: two families present, so "one light route" is not sufficient). high is excluded: one route kind only, no W-RICH.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Dimethicone deposition without cationic polymer is uncertain; realistic unknowns (silicone level, particle size) could move it to low.
weightPotential.counterSignal: No cationic polymer to aid silicone deposition; the second deposition family is only a trace ceramide-type additive after MENTHOL@10; moderate SLES reset.
